evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/b/a implements Runnable, owns two int[500] coordinate arrays, one synchronized sample index and a running boolean, and holds the live Client.
While enabled, run() synchronizes on its lock, samples Client.hP and Client.hQ into the paired arrays while index<500, increments the index and sleeps exactly 50 ms before repeating.
This field shape and 50 ms mouse-coordinate sampling loop is the long-standing classic RuneScape MouseDetection helper rather than a general timer or input dispatcher.

candidates.note: Recovered classic RuneScape MouseDetection identity from exact-v308 shape and behavior.
